basic_details.job_title: ANDUAT Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 11 Associate Professor Posts
basic_details.post_name: Associate Professor (Family Resource Management & Consumer Science), Associate Professor (Human Development & Family Studies), Associate Professor (Vegetable Science) and 7 more
basic_details.short_information: Acharya Narendra Deva University of Agriculture & Technology (ANDUAT), Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh, has invited applications for 11 posts in 10 roles under Advt No. 14/2026. The posts include Associate Professor (Family Resource Management & Consumer Science), Associate Professor (Human Development & Family Studies), Associate Professor (Vegetable Science), Associate Professor (Fruit Science) and 6 more. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 5 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Demand Draft in favour of Comptroller, Acharya Narendra Deva University of Agriculture & Technology (ANDUAT), Kumarganj, Ayodhya-224 229 payable at SBI, ANDUAT branch (06925).

how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form from the university website www.nduat.org.
Attach a Demand Draft of the fee in favour of Comptroller, ANDUAT, payable at SBI, ANDUAT branch.
Enclose all requisite documents and two self-addressed envelopes with Rs. 56/- postage stamps.
Write post name, serial no. of post, Advt. No. and last date on top of the envelope.
Send by Registered/Speed Post only to Director, Administration and Monitoring, ANDUAT, Kumarganj, Ayodhya; must reach by 05-12-2026, 5.00 PM.
Employed persons apply through proper channel; it must reach within 30 days after the closing date.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ANDUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ANDUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 11 vacancies: 1 Associate Professor (Family Resource Management & Consumer Science), 1 Associate Professor (Human Development & Family Studies), 1 Associate Professor (Vegetable Science), 1 Associate Professor (Fruit Science), 2 Associate Professor (Silviculture & Agroforestry), 1 Associate Professor (Floriculture & Land Scaping) and 4 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ANDUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (University website www.nduat.org) and send it to Director, Administration and Monitoring, Acharya Narendra Deva University of Agriculture & Technology, Kumarganj, Ayodhya, 224 229 (U.P.) India, by registered/speed post only; application by hand will not be accepted, to reach by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: UR/ OBC & EWS: Rs. 1500. SC/ST & PWD: Rs. 750. Applicants who applied in previous advertisement No. 2/2025: Exempted.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years (as on closing date i.e. 5/12/2026).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level 13A, entry pay Rs. 1,31,400 for Associate Professor (Family Resource Management & Consumer Science), Level 13A, entry pay Rs. 1,31,400 for Associate Professor (Human Development & Family Studies), Level 13A, entry pay Rs. 1,31,400 for Associate Professor (Vegetable Science), Level 13A, entry pay Rs. 1,31,400 for Associate Professor (Fruit Science), Level 13A, entry pay Rs. 1,31,400 for Associate Professor (Silviculture & Agroforestry).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's Degree with at least 55% marks in the concerned discipline, Ph.D. in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline with a good academic record, at least eight years of teaching/research experience with a minimum of seven publications, and a total research score of 75 (Appendix II, Table 2). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only Indian Nationals may apply. Horizontal reservation for PWD, dependent of freedom fighter, women and ex-servicemen as per Uttar Pradesh State Government rules. No concession of application fee for SC/ST candidates of other states. A person whose age is less than 18 years shall not be appointed.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: A person convicted by any Court of Law or against whom criminal proceedings are pending. A person who has married a person having a spouse living, or who, having a spouse living, has married any person (exemption possible). A person who is not a citizen of India. Holders of degrees from institutions declared fake by UGC.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening of applications on the Academic/Research (API) Score as per Table 2, Appendix-II of UGC Regulation 2018. Interview (Phase-II) of 20 marks; final selection solely on interview performance. A high level committee reviews the API Score submitted by the candidate before issuing interview call letters. Research score as per Table 2, Appendix-II of UGC Regulation 2018, from at least three of six categories.
